> 二十九章 熏香（第1页）
蓝烨磊正想着，只见一个丫环急匆匆的跑进来，上气不接下气的说道：“启禀将军，老爷刚才在书房晕倒了，夫人让我来请您过去看看。”
丫环刚刚说完，蓝烨磊就快步的奔向书房方向。
蓝烨磊与沈大人在书房下过几次棋，所以知道书房在哪里。
穿过府中的花园，紧走两步，书房已在眼前。
门前一个人影也不见，蓝烨磊不由得心中着急，看来岳父大人定是病的很重，不然怎么会没有人在外间听候吩咐，定是都在内间伺候着。
伸手推开房门，里面正好出来一个嬷嬷。这个嬷嬷蓝烨磊并不认识，但是那嬷嬷却认得他。
见他进来，便说道：“姑爷，您可来了，您快去看看，老爷这是怎么了？我去让管家传大夫来。”
待蓝烨磊进得房间，嬷嬷走出去关上房门。
房间散发出一种淡淡的梅花熏香的味道，这个季节，怎么会有这种香气呢？
蓝烨磊心中暗暗想着。却不得答案。
室内很安静，人都去了哪里？不是说岳父大人晕倒了吗？那众人应该是乱做一团不是吗？
“岳父大人？岳父大人？”蓝烨磊连声轻唤。
蓝烨磊的心中甚是奇怪，难道，大家都在内室？
上次与沈大人下棋下的晚了些，沈大人便住在书房。蓝烨磊记得他陪同沈大人一同进了内室，那是个很大的隔间，因为沈大人经常批阅文件到很晚，又有喜爱看书的习惯，如若太晚了，就会留在内室休息，以免影响夫人们休息。
屋子里怎么如此闷热？蓝烨磊不禁扯了下衣领，散开个领扣，感觉好像是好了一些。
刚才秋日的太阳照的人暖洋洋的，一定是自己跑的太急，热气还未消退吧！
蓝烨磊心里想着，舔了下嘴唇，闷热的感觉又重了些。
进了内室，香气更浓了些，感觉也更热了。

内室里床上的帷幔放下了，隐隐约约看到床上躺着一个人。
那天的床上帷幔好像不是淡粉色，蓝烨磊心想着。
总感觉哪里似乎不对，可是却不知道到底是哪里不对劲。
没办法停下脚步，感觉越来越热，越来越热。
心中有个念头催促着他去打开帷幔，看看躺在里面的到底是什么人……
这个念头催促着他一直走到床边，抬手撩开帷幔，一幅活色生香的画面出现在眼前。
一个赤身仅着粉红色薄纱的女子侧身躺在里面，一只手游荡着划出腰间曼妙的曲线，女子的媚眼如丝，风情万种的看着她。
蓝烨磊血往上涌，女子的脸庞在脑海中放大、放大……
此刻的他只看到娇妻沈沛珊媚魅惑的躺在床上看着自己，动人的呻吟声在耳边响起。
自沈沛珊怀孕后，蓝烨磊一直没有再碰过她，禁欲已久的他，此刻看到娇妻如此勾引他，怎受得了。
撕扯掉自己身上的衣服，蓝烨磊粗鲁的抓住床上的人，重重的压了上去……

> Chapter 29 Incense (Page 1)
Lan Yelei was just thinking when he saw a maid hurried in and said out of breath: "General Qi, I just fainted in the study. Madam asked me to invite you to come over and have a look."
As soon as the maid finished speaking, Lan Yelei hurried towards the study.
Lan Yelei and Master Shen have played chess in the study several times, so they know where the study is.
Walking through the garden of the mansion and taking two steps, the study is already in front of you.
There was no one in front of the door, and Lan Yelei couldn't help but feel anxious. It seemed that his father-in-law must be very ill, otherwise why would there be no one outside to listen to his orders? He must be waiting inside.
He reached out and pushed open the door, and a grandma just came out. This nanny Lan Yelei didn't know him, but the nanny did recognize him.
Seeing him come in, he said: "Uncle, you are here. Go and see what's going on, sir? I'll ask the housekeeper to call the doctor."
After Lan Yelei entered the room, grandma walked out and closed the door.
The room exudes a faint smell of plum blossom incense. How can there be such a fragrance in this season?
Lan Yelei thought secretly in his heart. But no answer.
It's very quiet indoors. Where have everyone gone? Didn't you say that your father-in-law fainted? Then everyone must be in a mess, right?
"Father-in-law? Father-in-law?" Lan Yelei called softly.
Lan Yelei was very surprised. Could it be that everyone was in the inner room?
The last time we played chess with Mr. Shen, we played a little late, so Mr. Shen stayed in the study. Lan Yelei remembered that he accompanied Mr. Shen into the inner room. It was a large compartment because Mr. Shen often reviewed documents until very late and also liked to read. If it was too late, he would stay in the inner room to rest so as not to affect the rest of the ladies.
Why is it so stuffy in the house? Lan Yelei couldn't help but pull off his collar and unbutton it. He felt a little better.
Just now, the autumn sun was shining warmly on you. You must have been running too fast and the heat has not subsided yet!
Lan Yelei thought to himself, licking his lips, and the sultry feeling became stronger again.
Entering the inner room, the aroma is stronger and the feeling is hotter.
The curtains on the bed in the inner room were lowered, and a person could be vaguely seen lying on the bed.
The curtains on the bed that day didn't seem to be light pink, Lan Yelei thought to himself.
I always feel like something is wrong, but I don't know what is wrong.
I couldn't stop, it felt hotter and hotter.
A thought in his mind urged him to open the curtain and see who was lying inside...
This thought urged him to walk to the bedside, raise his hand to lift the curtain, and a vivid picture appeared in front of him.
A naked woman wearing only a pink tulle was lying sideways inside, with one hand wandering around to trace the graceful curves of her waist. The woman's eyes were as charming as silk, looking at her with all kinds of charm.
Lan Yelei's blood surged upward, and the woman's face enlarged and enlarged in his mind...
At this moment, he only saw his beloved wife Shen Peishan lying on the bed looking at him seductively, and her touching moans sounded in his ears.
Lan Yelei has not touched Shen Peishan since she became pregnant. He has been abstinent for a long time, how can he bear to see his lovely wife seducing him like this.
After tearing off his clothes, Lan Yelei roughly grabbed the person on the bed and pressed him down heavily...
